Intro: Have you considered joining my sacred apostlehood, lowly chef? To be the St. Andrew of my story? I assure you will be treated well as my first.
What was that? Those spoiled monsters? What hogwash has my brother been telling you? They are more than just some common spoiled!
They are the Four Horseman who will usher the end of this world! And it is my divine mission to wage war and overcome their attempts of destruction!
I have encountered and overcome three of them already, with War being the mightiest of them all! I am so close to achieving my destiny.
Success: I can feel your devout loyalty in these dishes. I hope you accept my offer soon, lowly chef.
Fail: Were you scared of my trials, lowly chef? Why waver on your quality now?
Reject: Rejecting me on the eve of my destiny? Foolish.
